dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public pages for each included clinic. It is not limited to the six Explore categories.

trust_policy.official_context_price: Clinic's own public planning/typical range rather than a personalized quote.
trust_policy.official_practice_price_page: Practice-wide price page applied to a documented branch.
trust_policy.public_pricing_directory: Third-party public pricing directory; rank below direct clinic-site pricing.
trust_policy.market_evidence: City/market range only; never count as a clinic price.

limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, phone-only and unindexed prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, member, per-unit, per-syringe, per-vial and per-graft semantics are preserved where the source exposed them.
A city can have fewer than 10 clinics in a category when enough credible numeric public pricing was not found; no fake clinics are added to hit a quota.
